{{Quote|You can find him with his girlfriend. She has a place on the upper east side of Happyland.|[[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]]|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
This '''apartment''' belonged to [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers]] and his girlfriend [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, Marcy murdered Movers in the apartment with the aide of her partner in crime, [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]]. They were discovered by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tera Sinube/Legends|Tera Sinube]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who notified the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] which responded to the apartment to investigate.
